prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create a polished itch.io cover image for the dark fantasy ASCII dungeon crawler game ABYSS. Landscape canvas, aspect ratio 315:250 (1.26:1), ideally 1260x1000 pixels. This is finished cover artwork, not a mockup.
Composition: enormous perfectly legible title "ABYSS" across the upper third, with ample breathing room from the edges. Beneath it, a lonely tiny adventurer carrying a golden torch stands before a vast ancient stone arch and stairs descending into a black underground chasm. Strong centered silhouette, ominous depth, minimal clutter. Title and scene must remain recognizable when reduced to a small storefront thumbnail.
Style: beautiful intricate colored ASCII character mosaic, all shapes including stone, stair edges, cloak, flame and title built from aligned monospace glyphs such as # + / | _ : . * =. Title has a bold solid-looking block-letter silhouette constructed from dense glyphs. Not a screenshot, no HUD. Restrained near-black and dark teal background, pale ivory title and stone edges, rich amber torch glow represented by warm-colored characters, subtle scattered teal glyphs in the darkness. Dramatic high contrast, restrained premium dark-fantasy mood, no neon rainbow, no photorealism or painterly surfaces. Keep all artwork within a safe border with dark negative space near edges. No border frame.
Exact text: ABYSS
No additional text, tagline, badges, platform logos, watermarks, or UI.
